title: Embedding + Reranker: config-triggered evaluation and calibration suite
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, reproducible offline evaluation and calibration pipeline that is triggered whenever embedding or reranker model/config changes are proposed. Goals: compute recall@k, precision@k, MRR, and embedding distribution drift metrics for each candidate change; attach a human-readable report and signal to CI and the monitoring dashboard; provide pass/fail gating for risky changes and a recommendation bucket for acceptable degradation vs cost trade-offs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) For any PR that modifies model artifact or serving config, the pipeline runs and produces a report with recall@1/5/10, precision@1/5, MRR, embedding cosine shift (population mean/std), and KS-test p-value. 2) Report is uploaded to the eval dashboard and a CI comment with link is created. 3) Alerts fire when delta against baseline exceeds configured thresholds (recall drop > 3 percentage points or KS p-value < 0.01). 4) Docs describing how to interpret metrics and an escalation playbook are published.

notes: Implementation plan: 1) Finalize fast-sample selection and CI runner (this sprint). 2) Add full-batch runner + baseline store (next sprint). 3) Hook into config-change events and add PR comment/CI gating. 4) Create alerting rules in PagerDuty for high-severity regressions and add a manual rollback runbook. Need to coordinate with infra for eval-cluster capacity and with PM for threshold tuning.
